    16  In this file we define `∫ x in a..b, f x ∂μ` to be `∫ x in Ioc a b, f x ∂μ` if `a ≤ b` and

    22  
    23  In order to avoid `if`s in the definition, we define `IntervalIntegrable f μ a b` as
